title: auto update window is shown every time when I run the program
author: zgabi
body_snippet: When I start the program it always shows the following window: I tried to click all buttons. (use the suggested options, customize setting now - then clicked appyl in the shown settings dialog) It seems that mRemoteNg is not saving that I already configured the auto update.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hey @zgabi, thank you so much for reporting this — great catch! 🎯

## Root Cause

We traced this to a **settings provider wiring issue specific to .NET 10**. Here's what was happening:

All 17 settings classes (including the one storing `CheckForUpdatesAsked`) were missing the `[SettingsProvider]` attribute in the correct namespace. They relied entirely on a runtime workaround (`PortableSettingsInitializer.WireProvider()`) that programmatically rewires each property's provider at startup.
